title: Issue (out-of-scope capture: bug or plan)
description: A queue for preserving defects and opportunities discovered during work, outside the current session scope, in a form that can be picked up in another session. The content contract and decisions for filing, triage and closure are defined in skills/dev-docs/knowledge/issue.md.

issue_type.description: bug = a deviation from existing expectations (specification, tests or declared invariants). plan = a new opportunity, improvement or unstarted task.

subject_paths.description: Repository-relative paths for the subject. dev-evidence recalls this issue when the paths overlap a change surface.

disposition_target.description: Document ID identifying the resolution (the resolving change or promoted ADR/design). A transition to done requires this or disposition_reason.

disposition_reason.description: The fix when resolved without a change, or the reason for rejection. Required when transitioning to rejected.
